thread:
camille: Quick sync — we need a concise mapping for exceptions across chat/embeds/rerank/tool-calls. Customer asks piling up.
raj: Agreed. Can we scope this into MUST/SHOULD for launch?
megan: Yes. My suggestion: map transient infra/model issues to 503 + Retry-After; validation/contract errors to 422; user rate-limit to 429 with quota info.
raj: For embeddings, what about partial results if one shard times out — 206? Or prefer 200 with `partial: true` in body?
camille: prefer 200 with `partial_hit: true` and `items` + `errors` array so client can surface per-input failures.
megan: +1, consistent shape across endpoints helps SDKs. For rerank, tie the failure to item index.
oliver_d: Tool/function calling: need clear error when tool not available vs tool runtime error. propose 424 for dependency failed and 500 for tool crash.
raj: 424 is reasonable for downstream dependency. Add `retryable: false` for 424 and `retryable: true/false` flags in payload for others.
ops-bot: deploy-note: added `api-error-shapes` doc to /docs/internal — review required.
camille: Launch criteria: docs + SDK adapters + 1 integration test per endpoint for all error types, plus a customer-facing FAQ.
megan: Prioritization: Tier 1 (chat + embeddings), Tier 2 (rerank), Tier 3 (structured-output/toolchain semantics). Any objections?
raj: No objections. timeline: aim for canary in 2 weeks for Tier 1.
camille: I'll draft the mapping table (HTTP, code, retry semantics, body shape) and post a PR. tagging @megan @raj for review. :thumbsup: 
megan: ping if you want me to mock SDK errors.
raj: Also add guidance for 429: include `quota_reset` unix ts and `quota_window` in seconds.
camille: noted. We'll include an examples section with `curl` snippets and response bodies.
megan: example snippet for rate limit:
```\nHTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests\nContent-Type: application/json\n{\n  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",\n  "retry_after": 30,\n  "quota_reset": 1764000300\n}\n```
raj: Good. One more: model unavailable -> 503 with `fallback_model` hint when possible.
camille: ok — fallback hint is optional but valuable for Customer Success.
megan: I'll coordinate with CS for customer-visible messaging.
oliver_d: +1 on including per-route cost impact in the doc so product can see tradeoffs.
camille: Great. I'll post PR by EOD for review. Thanks everyone.
